summary.text: Victoria Maddox is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 85 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Tim Barhorst.
Maddox, who works in manufacturing and is a Logan County resident, ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Victoria Maddox was born in Bellefontaine, Ohio, earned a high school diploma from the TRECA Digital Academy and a bachelor's degree from Everest University in 2016, and has been affiliated with Logan County Democrats.
Her career experience includes working in manufacturing.
Tim Barhorst defeated Maddox in the 2024 general election for District 85.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Maddox said she earned a degree in criminal justice, has worked in manufacturing or fast food her whole life, and decided that changing policy is the most effective way to help people.
In that survey she said she wanted to limit corporate purchases of single-family homes and examine electricity rate increases approved by the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio.
